segments.he: עִקַּר הַתְּשׁוּבָה הוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת
segments.en: In truth there is no obstacle at all. Only the primary obstacle is the darkness — which is called an obstacle. As it is written: "and you did not withhold" — meaning what misleads a person with confusions and follies and darkens before his eyes with illusion, until it seems to him that there is no opening before him to draw close to Hashem. But in truth the path of life is laid before every person in the world. Even in the lowest depths one can draw close to Hashem, as Rabbainu of blessed memory taught many times. Only the person is blind and cannot see the opening because of the kelipas that are called darkness — which are the primary obstacles. For they darken the light of a person's eyes until he cannot see the opening. In the aspect of: "and the men who were at the door of the house they struck with blindness" [Bereishis 19:11] — "and they wearied themselves to find the door" — for one who is not worthy to enter, his eyes are darkened with blindness until he wearies himself finding the door.

segments.he: עִקַּר הִתְעוֹרְרוּת הַתְּשׁוּבָה זוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת. כִּי לִזְכּוֹת לִתְשׁוּבָה לָאו כָּל אָדָם זוֹכֶה מֵרִבּוּי הַמְּנִיעוֹת שֶׁיֵּשׁ עַל זֶה. וְעַל כֵּן עִקַּר הַמְשָׁכַת דֶּרֶךְ הַתְּשׁוּבָה בָּעוֹלָם הוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת כִּי לָשׁוּב בִּתְשׁוּבָה קָשֶׁה מְאד כִּי מַה בִּתְחִלָּה קדֶם שֶׁחָטָא. שֶׁעֲדַיִן לא נִמְשַׁךְ אַחַר יִצְרוֹ הָרַע הִתְגַּבֵּר עָלָיו הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע עַד שֶׁהֶחְטִיאוֹ מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן עַתָּה שֶׁכְּבָר נִמְשַׁךְ אַחֲרָיו וְנִתְפַּס בִּמְצוּדָתוֹ אֵיךְ אֶפְשָׁר לָשׁוּב. אַךְ עִקַּר הַתְּשׁוּבָה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינָה הַנַּ"ל עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת. כִּי עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה יְכוֹלִין לִפְעל הַכּל. כִּי אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוּא. וּכְבָר נִתְפַּס בְּתַאֲוֹתָיו הָרָעוֹת שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לוֹ שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לָצֵאת מִשָּׁם אַף עַל פִּי כֵן עַל כָּל פָּנִים הַדִּבּוּר בְּיָדוֹ. וְאִם יַרְבֶּה לְדַבֵּר דִּבּוּרֵי תְּפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים וְיִתְפַּלֵּל הַרְבֵּה לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לָשׁוּב וּלְקַיֵּם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה בְּוַדַּאי יְעוֹרֵר רַחֲמֵי ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ עָלָיו עַד שֶׁיִּפְתַּח לוֹ ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ שַׁעֲרֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה וְיִזְכֶּה סוֹף כָּל סוֹף לָשׁוּב אֶל ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ וִירַחֲמֵהוּ.
segments.en: Therefore there is no wisdom and no understanding and no counsel to stand against them except through truth. In every place he is, one must look only upon the truth — wherever one is — and speak words of truth in one's prayer and supplication according to what one is. Even if one cannot pray or speak between oneself and one's Maker at all — even so, one must see at least to speak the word one speaks in truth. For example, to say: "Master of the Universe, save me" — and say these words in truth at least. And similarly with other words. At least say them in truth. Even if one cannot bring them forth with vitality and fervor as is fitting — at least say them plainly in truth. And then the truth will shine upon him and he will merit to see the opening — and then he will certainly merit to enter into holiness. For there is no obstacle at all, as above — and as soon as one sees the opening, one enters into holiness safely.

segments.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁכָּתַב רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בְּלִקּוּטֵי תִּנְיָנָא. ע"ג הַנַּ"ל) שֶׁעִקַּר הַתְּשׁוּבָה עַל יְדֵי אֲמִירַת תְּהִלִּים. כִּי כָּל סֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים הֵם תְּחִנּוֹת וּבַקָּשׁוֹת שֶׁל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁבִּקֵּשׁ מֵה' יִתְבָּרַךְ לִזְכּוֹת לְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו וּלְקַיֵּם תּוֹרָתוֹ וּמִצְוֹתָיו. כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת ד' אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית ד' כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי וְכוּ'. וּכְתִיב הוֹרֵנִי ד' דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ וְכוּ' עָזְרֵנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ וְכוּ' וְכֵן הַרְבֵּה. וְכָל מַה שֶּׁמְּבַקֵּשׁ לְהִנָּצֵל מֵאוֹיבָיו וְשׂוֹנְאָיו כָּל כַּוָּנָתוֹ לְהִנָּצֵל מִשּׂוֹנְאֵי הַנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁהֵם הַסִּטְרָא אָחֳרָא וְחֵילוֹתָיו וְגַם כָּל הַשּׂוֹנְאִים בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת שֶׁבִּקֵּשׁ לְהִנָּצֵל מֵהֶם הַכּל הָיָה בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוֹת כִּי כָּל הַשּׂוֹנְאִים שֶׁל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם וְשֶׁל כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מֵחֲמַת שֶׁאָנוּ אוֹחֲזִין בְּתוֹרַת ד' וּמִצְוֹתָיו שֶׁבִּשְׁבִיל זֶה הֵם מִתְגָּרִים בָּנוּ נִמְצָא שֶׁכָּל שׂוֹנְאֵינוּ וְאוֹיְבֵינוּ בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת כֻּלָּם הֵם שׂוֹנְאֵי ד' שׂוֹנְאֵי הַנֶּפֶשׁ שׂוֹנְאֵי הַתּוֹרָה.
segments.en: A person of sound mind should be content even if through all his service and toil and exertion, the only result is that he is saved once in his life from some actual transgression or evil thought or desire — meaning that through his service and prayer and hisbodidus he merits that at the end of his days he has one fewer transgression — that is, through his service he merited that now he has one fewer sin in the reckoning of his transgressions than he would have had if he had not strived and prayed to be saved from them. Even this would have been worthwhile for him. For in the end, nothing remains for a person from all his toil and exertion in this world except what he merited sometimes — to be saved from evil and transgressions, and to occasionally seize some commandments. And it is impossible to expand on this, for thousands and tens of thousands of pages would not suffice to explain how far a person must always strengthen himself in longing for Hashem and never release the will.

segments.he: וְכָל בַּקָּשָׁתֵנוּ לְהִנָּצֵל מֵהֶם הִוא לְהִנָּצֵל מִשּׂוֹנְאֵי הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְהַתּוֹרָה כְּדֵי שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה. הַכְּלָל שֶׁכָּל כַּוָּנַת דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בְּסֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים הִוא לְבַקֵּשׁ מֵה' יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוֹת וּלְהִנָּצֵל מִכָּל הַשּׂוֹנְאִים וְהַמּוֹנְעִים וְהַמְעַכְּבִים לַעֲבד אֶת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת וּבְרוּחָנִיּוּת וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה שֶׁדָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ יָסַד כָּל סֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים מֵהִתְבּוֹדְדוּת שֶׁלּוֹ וְכוּ' (כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּסִימָן קנ"ו) עַיֵּן שָׁם. וְעַל כֵּן הֵם חֲמִשָּׁה סְפָרִים תְּהִלִּים כְּנֶגֶד חֲמִשָּׁה חֻמְּשֵׁי תּוֹרָה שֶׁהֵם כְּלַל הַתּוֹרָה.
segments.en: The primary strengthening — to merit remaining established in one's standing always, fulfilling "if I ascend to heaven, there You are; if I make my bed in the depths, there You are" [Tehillim 139:8] — to hold fast to Hashem always through all the falls and descents in the world, and even in the very lowest depths not to despair in any way — is through prayer. For the primary teshuvah is prayer. For according to the Torah there would be no remedy at all for the transgressor in the world, as explained in the words of our Rabbis of blessed memory. But Hashem desires kindness and wants teshuvah, and He established teshuvah before the world. And teshuvah is above the Torah — for there in the aspect of teshuvah, everything is transformed for good and deliberate sins become merits. And the primary teshuvah is prayer — for prayer is also above the Torah, as explained in the words of Rabbainu of blessed memory in many places.

segments.he: הַיְנוּ בְּחִינָה הַנַּ"ל שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת כִּי דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָשָׂה מֵחֲמִשָּׁה חֻמְּשֵׁי תּוֹרָה חֲמִשָּׁה סִפְרֵי תְּהִלִּים שֶׁהֵם תְּפִלּוֹת וּבַקָּשׁוֹת. הַיְנוּ שֶׁעָשָׂה מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר שְׁלֵמוּת הַתְּפִלָּה כַּנַּ"ל. וְעַל כֵּן עִקַּר הִתְעוֹרְרוּת הַתְּשׁוּבָה הוּא עַל יְדֵי תְּהִלִּים כַּנַּ"ל כִּי עִקַּר הַתְּשׁוּבָה זוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת תְּהִלִּים כַּנַּ"ל. (שָׁם אוֹת ז):
segments.en: For prayer is "things that stand at the very heights of the world" as our Rabbis of blessed memory taught — which is the aspect of the hidden things of the Torah, above the Torah, as written in the Torah teaching Chotam B'toch Chotam [Likutay Moharan 22] — see there. Therefore one who wishes to return to Hashem in truth — the primary complete teshuvah is through prayer: to always pray to Hashem to have mercy upon him from now on and save him from transgressions. For in truth every person is in great and immense danger in this world, especially the baal teshuvah who has already stumbled in what he has stumbled — how will he merit teshuvah? For every day his inclination overpowers him, as our Rabbis taught. And the more a person wishes to overpower the adversary, the more it overpowers him — for whoever is greater than his fellow, his inclination is greater than him. And as one sees with one's own eyes — it is like two people fighting each other: when one sees that the other is gaining on him, he exerts himself further. If so, how will he merit teshuvah? For as soon as he wants to overpower what he needs to overpower, they overpower him further. Therefore the primary thing is prayer and hisbodidus — to accustom oneself to seclude oneself every single day between oneself and one's Maker, and to cast one's plea before Hashem, who is full of compassion at all times, to grant him complete teshuvah in truth. And even if he sees that he is not accomplishing anything through his prayer and they still overpower him further — even so, let him do his part and pray always to Hashem, perhaps He will take pity and have compassion. As it is written: "hope to Hashem" [Tehillim 27:14] — and Rashi explains: "and if your prayer was not accepted, strengthen yourself and take courage, and hope again to Hashem." And our Rabbis taught: if a person sees that he prayed and was not answered, let him return and pray again, as it is said: "hope to Hashem, strengthen yourself and let your heart take courage, and hope to Hashem."

aligned_segments.he: עִקַּר הַתְּשׁוּבָה הוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת

aligned_segments.he: כִּי עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה יְכוֹלִין לִפְעל הַכּל.
aligned_segments.en: At least say them in truth.

aligned_segments.he: כִּי אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁהוּא.
aligned_segments.en: Even if one cannot bring them forth with vitality and fervor as is fitting — at least say them plainly in truth.

aligned_segments.he: וּכְבָר נִתְפַּס בְּתַאֲוֹתָיו הָרָעוֹת שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לוֹ שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לָצֵאת מִשָּׁם אַף עַל פִּי כֵן עַל כָּל פָּנִים הַדִּבּוּר בְּיָדוֹ.
aligned_segments.en: And then the truth will shine upon him and he will merit to see the opening — and then he will certainly merit to enter into holiness.

aligned_segments.he: וְאִם יַרְבֶּה לְדַבֵּר דִּבּוּרֵי תְּפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים וְיִתְפַּלֵּל הַרְבֵּה לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לָשׁוּב וּלְקַיֵּם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה בְּוַדַּאי יְעוֹרֵר רַחֲמֵי ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ עָלָיו עַד שֶׁיִּפְתַּח לוֹ ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ שַׁעֲרֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה וְיִזְכֶּה סוֹף כָּל סוֹף לָשׁוּב אֶל ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ וִירַחֲמֵהוּ.
aligned_segments.en: For there is no obstacle at all, as above — and as soon as one sees the opening, one enters into holiness safely.

aligned_segments.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁכָּתַב רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בְּלִקּוּטֵי תִּנְיָנָא.
aligned_segments.en: A person of sound mind should be content even if through all his service and toil and exertion, the only result is that he is saved once in his life from some actual transgression or evil thought or desire — meaning that through his service and prayer and hisbodidus he merits that at the end of his days he has one fewer transgression — that is, through his service he merited that now he has one fewer sin in the reckoning of his transgressions than he would have had if he had not strived and prayed to be saved from them.

aligned_segments.he: ע"ג הַנַּ"ל) שֶׁעִקַּר הַתְּשׁוּבָה עַל יְדֵי אֲמִירַת תְּהִלִּים. כִּי כָּל סֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים הֵם תְּחִנּוֹת וּבַקָּשׁוֹת שֶׁל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁבִּקֵּשׁ מֵה' יִתְבָּרַךְ לִזְכּוֹת לְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו וּלְקַיֵּם תּוֹרָתוֹ וּמִצְוֹתָיו.
aligned_segments.en: Even this would have been worthwhile for him.

aligned_segments.he: כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת ד' אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית ד' כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי וְכוּ'.
aligned_segments.en: For in the end, nothing remains for a person from all his toil and exertion in this world except what he merited sometimes — to be saved from evil and transgressions, and to occasionally seize some commandments.

aligned_segments.he: וּכְתִיב הוֹרֵנִי ד' דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ וְכוּ' עָזְרֵנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ וְכוּ' וְכֵן הַרְבֵּה. וְכָל מַה שֶּׁמְּבַקֵּשׁ לְהִנָּצֵל מֵאוֹיבָיו וְשׂוֹנְאָיו כָּל כַּוָּנָתוֹ לְהִנָּצֵל מִשּׂוֹנְאֵי הַנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁהֵם הַסִּטְרָא אָחֳרָא וְחֵילוֹתָיו וְגַם כָּל הַשּׂוֹנְאִים בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת שֶׁבִּקֵּשׁ לְהִנָּצֵל מֵהֶם הַכּל הָיָה בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוֹת כִּי כָּל הַשּׂוֹנְאִים שֶׁל דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם וְשֶׁל כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מֵחֲמַת שֶׁאָנוּ אוֹחֲזִין בְּתוֹרַת ד' וּמִצְוֹתָיו שֶׁבִּשְׁבִיל זֶה הֵם מִתְגָּרִים בָּנוּ נִמְצָא שֶׁכָּל שׂוֹנְאֵינוּ וְאוֹיְבֵינוּ בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת כֻּלָּם הֵם שׂוֹנְאֵי ד' שׂוֹנְאֵי הַנֶּפֶשׁ שׂוֹנְאֵי הַתּוֹרָה.
aligned_segments.en: And it is impossible to expand on this, for thousands and tens of thousands of pages would not suffice to explain how far a person must always strengthen himself in longing for Hashem and never release the will.

aligned_segments.he: וְכָל בַּקָּשָׁתֵנוּ לְהִנָּצֵל מֵהֶם הִוא לְהִנָּצֵל מִשּׂוֹנְאֵי הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְהַתּוֹרָה כְּדֵי שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה.
aligned_segments.en: The primary strengthening — to merit remaining established in one's standing always, fulfilling "if I ascend to heaven, there You are; if I make my bed in the depths, there You are" [Tehillim 139:8] — to hold fast to Hashem always through all the falls and descents in the world, and even in the very lowest depths not to despair in any way — is through prayer. For the primary teshuvah is prayer.

aligned_segments.he: הַכְּלָל שֶׁכָּל כַּוָּנַת דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בְּסֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים הִוא לְבַקֵּשׁ מֵה' יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה לְקַיֵּם אֶת הַתּוֹרָה וְהַמִּצְוֹת וּלְהִנָּצֵל מִכָּל הַשּׂוֹנְאִים וְהַמּוֹנְעִים וְהַמְעַכְּבִים לַעֲבד אֶת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת וּבְרוּחָנִיּוּת וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה שֶׁדָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ יָסַד כָּל סֵפֶר תְּהִלִּים מֵהִתְבּוֹדְדוּת שֶׁלּוֹ וְכוּ' (כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּסִימָן קנ"ו) עַיֵּן שָׁם.
aligned_segments.en: For according to the Torah there would be no remedy at all for the transgressor in the world, as explained in the words of our Rabbis of blessed memory. But Hashem desires kindness and wants teshuvah, and He established teshuvah before the world.

aligned_segments.he: וְעַל כֵּן הֵם חֲמִשָּׁה סְפָרִים תְּהִלִּים כְּנֶגֶד חֲמִשָּׁה חֻמְּשֵׁי תּוֹרָה שֶׁהֵם כְּלַל הַתּוֹרָה.
aligned_segments.en: And teshuvah is above the Torah — for there in the aspect of teshuvah, everything is transformed for good and deliberate sins become merits. And the primary teshuvah is prayer — for prayer is also above the Torah, as explained in the words of Rabbainu of blessed memory in many places.

aligned_segments.he: הַיְנוּ בְּחִינָה הַנַּ"ל שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת כִּי דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָשָׂה מֵחֲמִשָּׁה חֻמְּשֵׁי תּוֹרָה חֲמִשָּׁה סִפְרֵי תְּהִלִּים שֶׁהֵם תְּפִלּוֹת וּבַקָּשׁוֹת.
aligned_segments.en: For prayer is "things that stand at the very heights of the world" as our Rabbis of blessed memory taught — which is the aspect of the hidden things of the Torah, above the Torah, as written in the Torah teaching Chotam B'toch Chotam [Likutay Moharan 22] — see there. Therefore one who wishes to return to Hashem in truth — the primary complete teshuvah is through prayer: to always pray to Hashem to have mercy upon him from now on and save him from transgressions. For in truth every person is in great and immense danger in this world, especially the baal teshuvah who has already stumbled in what he has stumbled — how will he merit teshuvah?

aligned_segments.he: הַיְנוּ שֶׁעָשָׂה מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר שְׁלֵמוּת הַתְּפִלָּה כַּנַּ"ל.
aligned_segments.en: For every day his inclination overpowers him, as our Rabbis taught. And the more a person wishes to overpower the adversary, the more it overpowers him — for whoever is greater than his fellow, his inclination is greater than him. And as one sees with one's own eyes — it is like two people fighting each other: when one sees that the other is gaining on him, he exerts himself further. If so, how will he merit teshuvah?

aligned_segments.he: וְעַל כֵּן עִקַּר הִתְעוֹרְרוּת הַתְּשׁוּבָה הוּא עַל יְדֵי תְּהִלִּים כַּנַּ"ל כִּי עִקַּר הַתְּשׁוּבָה זוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי שֶׁעוֹשִׂין מִתּוֹרוֹת תְּפִלּוֹת שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת תְּהִלִּים כַּנַּ"ל. (שָׁם אוֹת ז):
aligned_segments.en: For as soon as he wants to overpower what he needs to overpower, they overpower him further. Therefore the primary thing is prayer and hisbodidus — to accustom oneself to seclude oneself every single day between oneself and one's Maker, and to cast one's plea before Hashem, who is full of compassion at all times, to grant him complete teshuvah in truth. And even if he sees that he is not accomplishing anything through his prayer and they still overpower him further — even so, let him do his part and pray always to Hashem, perhaps He will take pity and have compassion. As it is written: "hope to Hashem" [Tehillim 27:14] — and Rashi explains: "and if your prayer was not accepted, strengthen yourself and take courage, and hope again to Hashem." And our Rabbis taught: if a person sees that he prayed and was not answered, let him return and pray again, as it is said: "hope to Hashem, strengthen yourself and let your heart take courage, and hope to Hashem."
